# Introduction

This file is used to conduct ordinal regression analysis on the survey responses of Recreational fishers from the SELTMP in 2025. Regressions test trends between responses to different ranked 1-10 questions, such as support for MPAs, against wether the respondent would be likely to report suspicious activity

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# R Setup & housekeeping
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = TRUE,
	include = TRUE,
	message = FALSE,
	warning = FALSE)

rm(list=ls())
objects()
```
